knowledge:
- key_parameters: arrayType=The platform type used, such as "450k", "EPIC", or "Sequencing" ;; REtype=The repetitive element type to predict, including "Alu", "L1", or "LTR" ;; annotation.source=The source of annotation databases, either "AH" (AnnotationHub) or "UCSC" (UCSC website) ;; genome=The genome build version, either "hg19" or "hg38" ;; RE=An optional GRanges object containing customized RE genomic locations (e.g., Alu.hg19.demo) ;; ncore=Number of cores to use for parallel processing ;; seed=Seed number for reproducible random forest/machine learning results ;; method=The machine learning engine to use, defaulting to 'rf' (Random Forest), with options for Extreme Gradient Boosting, SVM with linear kernel, or SVM with radial kernel ;; threshold=Quality score threshold for trimming less reliable predictions (default = 1.7) ;; missingRate=The maximum allowed missing rate across samples to retain a CpG site (default = 0.2) ;; NCpG=The minimum number of predicted CpG sites required to aggregate RE-specific methylation (default = 2)
- alternatives: minfi=Recommended for preprocessing, quality control, and normalization of methylation data before running REMP ;; wateRmelon=Alternative package for preprocessing and normalizing methylation data ;; methylumi=Alternative package for preprocessing and normalizing methylation data ;; ENmix=Recommended to identify CpGs with multimodal distribution, as KNN-imputation in grooMethy may not be correct for them
- when_to_use: Use when you need genome-wide, single-base resolution DNA methylation of locus-specific repetitive elements (Alu, LINE-1, LTR) from Illumina 450k/EPIC array or sequencing data to enable downstream epigenome-wide association studies (EWAS) or differentially methylated region (DMR) analyses.
- pitfalls: Zero beta values in the input data will cause negative infinite values during logit transformation to M-values; grooMethy automatically replaces them with the smallest non-zero beta value ;; NA, NaN, and Inf values can break the prediction; grooMethy applies KNN-imputation to fix them, but imputed values for multimodal distributed CpGs may be incorrect ;; For sequencing data, the genome build of the Seq.GR object must match the genome build specified in the genome argument ;; If work.dir is not specified in initREMP, the generated annotation parcel is saved in the temporal directory tempdir() and will be lost when the R session ends; it is highly recommended to specify a permanent working directory to reuse the parcel

workflows.name: repetitive_element_methylation_prediction
workflows.intent: Predict DNA methylation of locus-specific repetitive elements (RE) from user-provided DNA methylation data.
input: user_methylation_data.RData (RatioSet, GenomicRatioSet, data.table, data.frame, DataFrame, or matrix of beta or M-values)
user_seq_gr.RData (Optional GRanges object containing CpG genomic locations, required only if using sequencing data)
workflows.stages: 1. Groom and preprocess the methylation data using grooMethy ;; 2. Prepare and initialize the annotation data parcel using initREMP ;; 3. Save the generated annotation parcel to the working directory using saveParcel ;; 4. Run the machine learning-based prediction using remp ;; 5. Trim off less reliable predicted results using rempTrim ;; 6. Aggregate predicted CpG methylation to RE-specific levels using rempAggregate ;; 7. Add genomic region annotations to the predicted REs using decodeAnnot ;; 8. Plot the density of the predicted methylation values using remplot
workflows.code:
GM12878_450k <- getGM12878('450k') 
GM12878_450k <- grooMethy(GM12878_450k)
data(Alu.hg19.demo)
remparcel <- initREMP(arrayType = "450k",
                     REtype = "Alu",
                     annotation.source = "AH",
                     genome = "hg19",
                     RE = Alu.hg19.demo,
                     ncore = 1)
saveParcel(remparcel)
remp.res <- remp(GM12878_450k, 
                 REtype = 'Alu', 
                 parcel = remparcel, 
                 ncore = 1, 
                 seed = 777)
remp.res
details(remp.res)
rempB(remp.res)
rempM(remp.res)
rowRanges(remp.res)
rempImp(remp.res)
metadata(remp.res)$Seed
remp.res <- rempTrim(remp.res, threshold = 1.7, missingRate = 0.2)
details(remp.res)
remp.res <- rempAggregate(remp.res, NCpG = 2)
details(remp.res)
remp.res <- decodeAnnot(remp.res)
rempAnnot(remp.res)
remplot(remp.res, main = "Alu methylation (GM12878)", col = "blue")

workflows.name: extract_profiled_re_methylation
workflows.intent: Extract directly profiled methylation data of CpGs located within repetitive elements from Illumina BeadChip array data without running predictions.
input: user_methylation_data.RData (RatioSet, GenomicRatioSet, data.table, data.frame, DataFrame, or matrix of beta or M-values from Illumina 450k or EPIC arrays)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract the profiled RE-CpG methylation data using remprofile ;; 2. Aggregate the extracted CpG methylation to RE-specific levels using rempAggregate
workflows.code:
GM12878_450k <- getGM12878('450k') 
GM12878_450k <- grooMethy(GM12878_450k)
data(Alu.hg19.demo)
remp.res <- remprofile(GM12878_450k, 
                       REtype = "Alu", 
                       annotation.source = "AH", 
                       genome = "hg19", 
                       RE = Alu.hg19.demo)
details(remp.res)
remp.res <- rempAggregate(remp.res)
details(remp.res)
